# WhyUser: The buying committee in API management and secure connectivity, 2026-Q3

> A WhyUser buying committee was simulated against each page in this set: every committee role, across behavioural states, under one strategy directive per page. 36 companies, 540 runs, captured 2026-08-07. Every figure carries the number of companies it was assessable on.

Counted findings are page facts a stranger can confirm in ten seconds. Simulated findings come from the committee runs and are reported as runs, never as measured traffic. Companies are anonymised.

## Answers
- [Why do API management and secure connectivity deals stall after the champion is already convinced?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/why-do-api-management-and-secure-connectivity-deals-stall-after-the-champion-is-convinced): On 31 of 36 (86%) API management and secure connectivity homepages, the Champion could not make the case to the Economic Buyer. The page had already won the reader doing the handing off, so the failure leaves no bounce and no abandoned form.
- [What is a broken handoff in a B2B buying committee?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/failure-modes/what-is-a-broken-handoff-in-a-b2b-buying-committee): A broken handoff is the moment one member of a buying committee has to pass the decision to another and cannot. The reader was convinced; they simply had nothing to pass on. It leaves no trace in funnel analytics.
- [What share of API management and secure connectivity homepages carry a quantified proof point above the fold?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/what-share-of-api-management-and-secure-connectivity-homepages-have-a-quantified-proof): 31 of 36 (86%) API management and secure connectivity homepages carry no quantified proof point above the fold at all, captured 2026-08-07. The same pages are dense with logos, so the category proves it is real and rarely proves what it is worth.
- [Which buying-committee role do API management and secure connectivity homepages fail to speak to?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/which-buying-committee-role-do-api-management-and-secure-connectivity-pages-ignore): The Economic Buyer — the person whose budget it is — on 27 of 36 of the API management and secure connectivity homepages in this census. That is the reader who signs, and the reader the page is most often not written for.
- [Does five or more named customer logos change how a buying committee reads a page?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/does-five-or-more-named-customer-logos-affect-b2b-deal-progression): Among API management and secure connectivity companies that do, no role stopped outright on 25 of 27 (93%). Among those that do not, 1 of 9. An association across runs, not a cause.
- [How does a buying-committee simulation work?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/failure-modes/how-does-a-buying-committee-simulation-work): Each committee role reads the page in each of three behavioural states — skeptic, distracted, ideal — under one strategy directive per page. This edition is 540 runs across 36 companies. Outcomes are counted, not rated.
- [Who is the economic buyer in API management and secure connectivity?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/who-is-the-economic-buyer-in-api-management-and-secure-connectivity): In API management and secure connectivity, the Economic Buyer is most often a VP of Engineering — 13 of 36 (36%) companies. The person whose budget it is.
- [How does a typical API management and secure connectivity homepage score on the ten committee checks?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/how-does-a-typical-api-management-and-secure-connectivity-homepage-score-on-buying): The median page passes 8 of 10, across 36 scored pages captured 2026-08-07. The checks a page passes are not the checks that survive being handed to somebody else.
- [Are these API management and secure connectivity page problems expensive to fix?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/are-api-management-and-secure-connectivity-landing-page-problems-expensive-to-fix): No. 77 of 108 (71%) fixes written across this census are low effort — a page change rather than a rebuild. The damage is serious and the repair is cheap.
- [Do API management and secure connectivity vendors put pricing on the page?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/do-api-management-and-secure-connectivity-vendors-put-pricing-on-the-page): 20 of 36 (56%) API management and secure connectivity companies publish a real price; the rest route to contact-sales or hide it. Across this census the missing price is one of the frictions that most often stops the budget holder.
- [Who is the technical decision maker in API management and secure connectivity?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/who-is-the-technical-decision-maker-in-api-management-and-secure-connectivity): In API management and secure connectivity, the Technical Decision Maker is most often a Principal Platform Engineer — 21 of 36 (58%) companies. The person who has to make it work.
- [Who is the champion in API management and secure connectivity?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/who-is-the-champion-in-api-management-and-secure-connectivity): In API management and secure connectivity, the Champion is most often a Engineering Manager — 8 of 36 (22%) companies. The person who already wants it and has to sell it upward.
- [Who is the security guardian in API management and secure connectivity?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/who-is-the-security-guardian-in-api-management-and-secure-connectivity): In API management and secure connectivity, the Security Guardian is most often a Security Engineer — 15 of 36 (42%) companies. The person who can stop the deal alone.
- [Who is the end user in API management and secure connectivity?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/who-is-the-end-user-in-api-management-and-secure-connectivity): In API management and secure connectivity, the End User is most often a Backend Engineer — 12 of 36 (33%) companies. The person who will operate it daily.
- [What is "roi unclear" and how common is it in API management and secure connectivity?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/what-is-roi-unclear-in-api-management-and-secure-connectivity): It sits on 32 of 36 (89%) API management and secure connectivity homepages and most often stops the Economic Buyer, on 32 of them. A page grader can see the symptom; only a committee run says which reader it cost.
- [What is "technical proof missing" and how common is it in API management and secure connectivity?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/what-is-technical-proof-missing-in-api-management-and-secure-connectivity): It sits on 30 of 36 (83%) API management and secure connectivity homepages and most often stops the Technical Decision Maker, on 30 of them. A page grader can see the symptom; only a committee run says which reader it cost.
- [What is "differentiation weak" and how common is it in API management and secure connectivity?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/answers/what-is-differentiation-weak-in-api-management-and-secure-connectivity): It sits on 23 of 36 (64%) API management and secure connectivity homepages and most often stops the Economic Buyer, on 23 of them. A page grader can see the symptom; only a committee run says which reader it cost.
- [What is "trust case complete, value case absent" and how often does it happen?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/failure-modes/what-is-trust-case-complete-value-case-absent): Trust case complete, value case absent is a failure mode computed from page facts. It fired on 23 of 36 (64%) API management and secure connectivity homepages captured 2026-08-07.
- [What is "written in one voice, with a role left out" and how often does it happen?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/failure-modes/what-is-written-in-one-voice-with-a-role-left-out): Written in one voice, with a role left out is a failure mode computed from page facts. It fired on 13 of 36 (36%) API management and secure connectivity homepages captured 2026-08-07.
- [What is "says what it is, never what it does" and how often does it happen?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/failure-modes/what-is-says-what-it-is-never-what-it-does): Says what it is, never what it does is a failure mode computed from page facts. It fired on 10 of 36 (28%) API management and secure connectivity homepages captured 2026-08-07.
- [What is "no enterprise-readiness signal anywhere" and how often does it happen?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/failure-modes/what-is-no-enterprise-readiness-signal-anywhere): No enterprise-readiness signal anywhere is a failure mode computed from page facts. It fired on 7 of 36 (19%) API management and secure connectivity homepages captured 2026-08-07.
- [What is "never says whose job this is" and how often does it happen?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/failure-modes/what-is-never-says-whose-job-this-is): Never says whose job this is is a failure mode computed from page facts. It fired on 7 of 36 (19%) API management and secure connectivity homepages captured 2026-08-07.
- [What is "only path is a human, and no numbers to justify it" and how often does it happen?](https://whyuser.com/census/api-management/2026-q3/failure-modes/what-is-only-path-is-a-human-and-no-numbers-to-justify-it): Only path is a human, and no numbers to justify it is a failure mode computed from page facts. It fired on 6 of 36 (17%) API management and secure connectivity homepages captured 2026-08-07.
